scope: Visible-light scalar approximations. Supplier nominal values are not independent RGB or angle-resolved measurements. Finished-sheet values already include the substrate; do not apply an extra acrylic transmission factor.

two_way_mirror.evidence: Supplier nominal technical specification for finished clear acrylic mirror. Spectral and directional response are not published.

black_led.evidence: Chemcast Black LED sheet: approximately 29% light transmission. Surface reflectance is a normal-incidence Fresnel estimate from PMMA n=1.49, not a measured black-sheet reflectance. This is a source cover, not a 70/30 mirror.

clear_reference.evidence: PERSPEX Design Guide Table 18 reports >92% transmission at 3 mm (ASTM D1003), refractive index 1.49 (ISO 489 A). 0.92 is a rounded conservative reference for uncoated clear stock; do not multiply it into finished mirror transmission.

black_mirror.evidence: Engineering estimate requested by Bryan, not measured data. Assume similar cavity-facing coating reflectance to the clear mirror. Clear finished mirror T=.30, black LED stock T=.29, clear stock T=.92 imply .30*.29/.92=.0946, rounded to .09. Cavity-facing absorption is then .21. Reverse-side reflection is rounded to .10 from PMMA surface reflection plus the attenuated coating return; reverse absorption is .81. Values describe the complete coated black sheet: never multiply by .29 again.
